# Aladdin Bookkeeping

> > Specialized bookkeeping and accounting services for Colorado construction contractors and skilled trades businesses.

Aladdin Bookkeeping provides expert bookkeeping, cleanup, and monthly accounting services specifically designed for contractors in construction, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, painting, landscaping, and roofing trades. With 15+ years of construction industry expertise, they serve the Denver and Colorado areas with QuickBooks integration and job-costing solutions.
